name: 大厅
info: 大厅是基地的核心建筑，为基地发展提供数码充能。\n大厅的等级象征着基地等级，决定着其他建筑的等级上限。此外，基地的负荷聚集于此，负荷的提升可使更多数码兽投入基地三大基础资源的产出。
info_tw: 大廳是基地的核心建築，為基地發展提供數碼充能。\n大廳的等級象徵著基地等級，決定著其他建築的等級上限。此外，基地的負荷聚集於此，負荷的提升可使更多數碼獸投入基地三大基礎資源的產出。
info_en: The hall is the core building of the base, whose level determines the upper limit of other buildings. In addition, the load of the base also controled by it. Increase of the load can make more digimons invest in the output of resource.

info_tw: 基地的西北方盛產富含金屬元素的數碼礦晶。\n晶石本無生命，但晶石中所富含的金屬元素，則是搭建數碼世界的必要元素，它們是數碼生物的賴以生存的介質，所以數碼礦晶被數碼獸們稱為生命之石。
info_en: The northwest of the base is rich in digital spar with metal elements. Spar is lifeless, but the metal elements rich in spar are the necessary elements to build a digital world. They are the medium for digital biology to live on.

info_en: There is a group of hard-working battery living in the energy storage factory. They work day and night to make the components produced in large quantities, and with the widespread use of components, the digital world has ushered in a major outbreak.

info_tw: 戰鬥累了就來小屋喝杯茶吧~\n傢俱不僅會將小屋裝點的華麗溫馨，更會為前線戰鬥的數碼獸增加戰力。傢俱的戰力加成擁有即生效，但擺在小屋更加物盡其用。
info_en: When you are tried of the battle, come to drink for a cup of tea in the cabin~\n Furniture will not only decorate the cabin magnificent and warm, but also increase the battle power for the digimon on the front line. The addition of battle power of the furniture is effective once processed, but it is more useful in the cabin.
